Dates, Minutes and Agendas

Ordinary Council Meetings are held on the second Tuesday of each month. The date may be subject to change in December.

Council Meeting is where discussions and decisions on Council items take place. The public have the opportunity to participate at the meeting by asking questions, making statements or making presentations. 

Find out more about public participation in Council meetings here

 

Meetings commence at 5:00pm in the Council Chambers, 26 Lyall Street, Westbury. Meeting dates and times are subject to change. Any changes will be advertised. Ordinary Meetings are also audio recorded and made available online.

 

The latest Meeting Agenda can be viewed four days before Council's Ordinary Meeting by clicking the current year's link below. A hard copy can be obtained from Council's office.

Minutes, Agendas and audio recordings from previous Meetings can be accessed by clicking on the links below. Audio recordings are available from April 2020 only.

For a printed copy, or for Minutes and Agendas from years prior to those published below, please phone the Office of the General Manager on (03) 6393 5317.

Live-streamed Meetings can be viewed here
